feedback:
Two notes before the judgment. First, the submitted artifact is not one proposal: it contains three successive drafts of the same design concatenated, the first two truncated mid-token (the first breaks inside D-015's consequences, the second inside the Input sources coverage entry). Only the third is complete, and I judged that one. The truncated fragments must be removed before this can be published, since as delivered the document contradicts itself by construction and does not parse against the author's schema. Second, the compression itself was the right response to the length instruction; the problem is the packaging, not the shorter text.

Most of the prior round's findings are genuinely closed, and I verified each against the current text rather than taking the claim. D-043 resolves the windowed-diarization contradiction: window output and centroid state live in a run-owned staging artifact, nothing enters segments or results until one publish transaction, cancellation deletes staging, and D-007 and D-031 now agree with that. D-037 carries prior assignments into a new diarization as unverified proposals with their source revision recorded, and the assigned_by_user invariant is stated once. D-023 replaces the fixture-only tone correction with a per-stream measured-rate estimator over host timestamps, stores the residual per artifact, marks alignment_degraded above the bound, disables echo marking there, and scores the estimator against tone ground truth in the fixture only. D-008 revalidates before every external effect including the accessibility write, and distinguishes held from unconfirmed by whether an effect had begun. D-030 records priming frames in the head record, source frames per data record and the full frame accounting in the seal record, with F3 asserting decoded valid frame count and trimming against retained reference PCM. D-040 keys the materialized registry by content and service to match the content-addressed path, and one retention invariant now governs blobs and caches consistently across D-038, the evolution section and verification, with adapter removal deleting nothing everywhere. Both rubrics are monotone, and F1 gains an absolute acceptance basis with a failure action that returns the latency question to the approver rather than letting engineering drop it. Failed model staging now has a table, a lifetime and a sweep rule that matches. Those objections no longer apply.

Of the new review's ten blocking items, nine hold in whole or in part and one is overstated.

Holding. (1) D-033 names installation smoke tests and materialization copies as model-lease holders, but its eligibility rule requires an installation row referencing that setHash already in state installed or orphaned_runtime. D-022 runs the smoke test against the staged path before that row is committed, so the named holder cannot satisfy the rule. This is the same gap the prior round asked to close for pre-capture work, closed for live preview and arming but not for installation. A staging-scoped lease keyed to the durable model_staging row and the prospective setHash would cover it, with a stated exclusion against sweeps and competing publication. (2) D-022 renames staging into Models/blobs/<setHash> and the earlier draft calls that path one never previously written, while D-040 and D-041 require two installations of identical content to share one blob under different notices. On the second such import the destination exists, so the sequence needs a verify-and-reference path, a no-replace rule, and a winner and cleanup rule for concurrent installers. (3) Scratch/<jobId> sits under Application Support, outside the service container, and the three access mechanisms in D-003 cover model assets only. F2 asserts that writes outside job scratch and materialized directories are denied without saying how a sandboxed service obtains the scratch path at all. Either move scratch into the container with store registration, or pass a directory handle per job, and say who removes it after a service crash. (4) D-004 defines eviction only for a higher-priority arrival, so two jobs at the interactive tier have no ordering: a second dictation arming while the first run's rewrite holds the generation slot and budget has no rule, and the interactive minimum covers speech-primary and the non-model floor but not the preview slot, which weakens D-011's claim that a rung is always available. Separately, admission charges non-model ingest a 200 MB ceiling while the decode-path range tolerates 300 MB of growth for the decoder alone, so the 8 GB figure does not cover every admitted process. (5) Delivery has per-attempt idempotency but no process-wide serialization. One actor per run plus deliveries that outlive their capture allow two coordinators to interleave writes into the same target and to nest pasteboard snapshots, in which case the second attempt snapshots the first attempt's transcript as the prior clipboard and later restores that. A single delivery executor with queue ordering, cancellation and revalidation on reaching the front closes it. (6) A service interruption puts a diarization run in failed(diarizing, interrupted), which the stage list calls terminal, and D-043 then re-admits that same run from staging. No transition permits leaving a terminal state, and nothing says what happens to state, ended_at and reason on resume or after a second crash. Either add a non-terminal resumable state or make resume a new run adopting the same manifest and staging, which then needs a rule for the run-scoped staging path. (7) Cross-window cluster matching is applied rather than proposed, on centroid distance, with no threshold, no tie rule and no no-match rule, while the same evidence type is deliberately left as a user-confirmed proposal for cross-recording identity because RESEARCH states the SDK supplies no universal threshold. The attribution state assigned is consumed by notes but produced by no stated transition. The 256-centroid cap says later windows match only against existing centroids, which forces a genuinely new speaker into an existing cluster. (9) The memory criteria treat failure to reject a zero slope as evidence of constant memory, which a three-point measurement can pass with a real slope; the document already uses the correct one-sided bound form for the preview arm's non-inferiority test and should use it here, and the ceilings anchored to a ten-minute-to-three-hour window admit growth that is unbounded at longer durations given no duration cap. (10) D-019 records a security-scoped bookmark with no table, no defined dereference and no deletion rule, which is the unowned persistent datum the specification asks not to defer, and is inconsistent with how D-039 treats retained context.

Overstated. (8) The demand that an observing adapter supply a monotonic state revision or command transaction identifier exceeds both REVIEW_NOTES, which asks for an adapter that identifies the player and observes the pause transition, and the prior judgment, which named playback position as an acceptable second token. D-025 does all of that, revokes ownership on any differing token component, any non-paused state and any unreadable token, keeps every other player on manual actions, and states the residual precisely: a play followed by a re-pause returning to the identical item and position. That is a narrow, disclosed case, not a claim of certainty. The one real refinement is that the open question asks only whether the token is readable and not what position granularity each player reports, which is what sets the collision rate.

The review's deferred items are mostly accurate and belong in the same pass: orphan notice directories written before an activation that never commits are absent from the launch sweep; the absolute recognition review does not define how its twenty transcripts are sampled or whether the correction rate is per transcript or pooled; and the Text delivery coverage entry says permission loss routes the result to History and the clipboard, while D-032 and the delivery rules hold the result and offer Copy. The priming-frame point is already answered, since the assumption records priming from the converter before any chunk is deleted and otherwise retains chunks until the artifact is verified.

Not stuck. Every confirmed defect is resolvable inside the design with the material at hand and none waits on a measurement: add a staging lease scope; give blob publication a verify-and-reference and concurrency rule; choose a scratch access mechanism; order equal-priority interactive work and charge ingest and decode against the budget; add a delivery executor; represent resume in the state machine; make cross-window links proposals with a stated threshold and no-match and overflow behavior, and either define a producer for assigned or remove it; restate the memory criteria as equivalence bounds with a duration-independent ceiling; and give the import bookmark a row and a deletion rule or drop it for non-authorizing metadata.

Check mapping. requirements is false for cross-window identity applied without a threshold, the unreachable assigned state that notes consume, cap overflow, the coverage claim of automatic clipboard placement, and the preview guarantee that equal-priority contention can defeat. architecture is false for scratch with no access mechanism, undefined ordering among interactive jobs, ingest and decode memory outside the summed budget, and the absent delivery executor. alternatives is true; each decision including D-043 weighs options that were genuinely available with their costs. data_lifecycle is false for the model-lease eligibility that excludes its own named holders, blob publication with no collision or concurrency rule, the unowned import bookmark, and unswept notice directories. failures is false for resume from a terminal state, concurrent delivery attempts corrupting pasteboard restoration, and unspecified match, tie and overflow behavior in diarization. maintainability is true; ordering, gates, extension paths, the runtime-replacement bound with retained-bytes reporting, and the accepted-cost list are specific and follow from the decisions. verification is false for the non-equivalence memory criteria, ceilings that permit unbounded growth at long durations, and the undefined sampling and aggregation in the usability review. unresolved_decisions is false because the scratch mechanism, blob collision handling, equal-priority scheduling, resume representation, delivery serialization, the cross-window threshold and the producer of assigned are all left to whichever implementation task reaches them first.
